title: Chapter 267: The Second Zerg Base
content:
Chapter 267: The Second Zerg Base

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the Zerg territory, where everything was very peaceful.

The underground Zerg territory was connected to the underground world on one end, and dug into the underground of the new city of Daxia Territory on the other end, connecting the Zerg territory and Daxia Territory in space.

After this period of continuous construction, the new city of Daxia Territory has been built. This is a city that is not large, but has a very unique style.

There are not many permanent residents. In addition to the original residents at the beginning, there are the refugees who first came here. Everyone built a home together. Wu Qing gave them a home in this city.

Because the Daxia Territory in a broad sense now refers to the entire forbidden land. In the eyes of outsiders, Daxia Territory and Zerg Territory actually refer to the same place.

It's just that for Wu Qing, Daxia Territory and the real Zerg territory are different.

In Wu Qing's mind, the place covered by the Zerg fungus blanket is the real Zerg territory, and other territories can only be regarded as the Zerg's sphere of influence.

GOOGLE search for TWKAN

The Zerg's sphere of influence also includes the Great Xia Territory and the semi-independent Alliance.

These cannot be confused.

The small place of the New City of the Great Xia Territory is the first territory of Wu Qing and the Zerg in this world. Wu Qing still gave the name of Great Xia to this small city.

This city, located on the real Zerg territory, was designed and planned by Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg. From now on, it will be called Great Xia City.

Naming it with Great Xia must have extraordinary significance.

Outside the Great Xia City, there are endless green fields. These are all various high-quality food crops cultivated and planted by the Flower Fairy Clan in combination with the Zerg biotechnology provided by the Queen of Zerg.

It is still in the experimental stage. When the experiment is successful, it will be promoted to the entire Zerg sphere of influence to solve the food problem within the Zerg sphere of influence.

The people of the Great Xia City now have everything they need and finally live a stable and peaceful life, which they dared not imagine before.

This is the welfare that Wu Qing gave to the first group of people who trusted him, so that everyone can live the life they want.

As long as these people are willing, Wu Qing will let them work and live here until they die.

Wu Qing will certainly provide opportunities for those who have ideals.

In addition to the small number of permanent people, the rest of Daxia City are all kinds of talents discovered by the Queen of Zerg within the Zerg's sphere of influence. They are transported here by Zerg transport hosts for concentrated learning.

After learning and gaining the Queen of Zerg's recognition, these talents will be sent to various places to take up important positions and assist the Queen of Zerg in managing various affairs in the territory.

Now the main responsible persons of major cities within the Zerg's sphere of influence have all had the experience of further study in Daxia City.

The Queen of Zerg uses Zerg biotechnology to speed up the learning speed of various talents and improve their learning efficiency. In a very short period of time, she has cultivated a large number of talents for Wu Qing.

Daxia City will gradually become a city that everyone yearns for.

…

Mengzhong City has developed very well because of the existence of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce has invested a lot of resources and rebuilt a city area with the Goblin Chamber of Commerce as the core.

The rapid development of cities and territories in the Zerg's sphere of influence is inseparable from the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, which has a large space transmission channel. Their trading teams coming and going have promoted the prosperity of Mengzhong City.

Guangfu City is also developing well because it is closest to Daxia City.

Daxia City, Mengzhong City and Guangfu City, these cities that were originally thought to play an important role, simply cannot keep up with the speed of Zerg development and are far behind.

These cities have not been fully built yet, and they have become insignificant to the current Zerg.

Compared with the main city of the 108th District of the Southern Theater Public Battlefield, Daxia City is not as good as a large courtyard in the main city, and the largest Guangfu City can only be compared with the main city station given to the Zerg by the goblins.

The gap is too big. If you really want to compare with the outside world, unless the territory snatched by the Zerg from the four major tribes, this forbidden land, is built as a giant city.

"This seems to be a good idea! Such a huge city deserves the name of Daxia City!"

This idea suddenly popped up, which made Wu Qing a little moved.

Since seeing the area of the main city, Wu Qing has a new view on the scale of cities in this world. He estimates that the scale of urban construction in this world is not worse than the world he originally lived in.

Many sources have mentioned that in the hinterland of the native camp, the clan lands of those super clans, there are also super cities that are much larger than the main city.

The description of many information made Wu Qing think that one city is a country.

So, when the Zerg develops in the future, building a Daxia City covering the entire forbidden land is a feasible idea.

"You have to eat one bite at a time and walk one step at a time. This matter has to be done slowly."

Wu Qing told the Queen of the Zerg about his general idea and asked it to move closer to the big goal of building a super Daxia City in the development plan of the forbidden land, the Zerg sphere of influence.

The Queen of Insects, a collective consciousness of the Zerg that has entered biological intelligence mode and possesses some of Wu Qing's personality, of course knows Wu Qing's thoughts best. Once Wu Qing makes a request, it can do things according to Wu Qing's thoughts.

Wu Qing continued to pay attention to the battle situation in the underground world and the situation of the Heavenly Silkworm Knights in various cities in the Southern Free Land, and then returned to his body and went to rest.

…

The next day.

Wu Qing was not in a hurry to pay attention to the situation in the 66th city. He had just experienced a great battle and there would be no enemies coming to the door for the time being.

Other things did not require Wu Qing to do personally, and the Queen of Zerg would be responsible for solving them.

The system now has sufficient resources, and the lineup of the Zerg army in the 66th city is already sufficient. It would be a waste to continue to increase the strength of the main combat arms or improve their strength.

It would be better to take out some of these resources and open up a new battlefield elsewhere.

The speed of intervening in the battlefield of the Southern Free Land Camp War through the Fold Ear Cat Tribe is too slow. Until now, the Fold Ear Cat Tribe has not determined the time to invite the Zerg to watch the battle.

Wu Qing handed over the cooperation with the Fold Ear Cat Tribe to the Alliance, and let Meng and Hu Tu and others talk about these things.

In the underground world, the Zerg puppies performed very well. They continued to compress the activity space of the underground Dire Wolf Tribe in the area close to the Zerg territory, and various information about the underground world was also constantly collected.

It is not appropriate to start a war in the underground world at this time. The Zerg has no allies in the underground world and faces unknown enemies alone. If the enemy is too strong, it will take up too much energy of the Zerg, which is not conducive to the development of the Zerg in the aboveground world.

The Zerg's main goal in the near future is to obtain the status of a large tribe in the local camp as soon as possible.

Therefore, it is more appropriate to open up a battlefield in the direction of the demon tribe's territory outside the forbidden land through the Zerg's sphere of influence.

The Zerg already has experience in fighting with the super tribe of the evil god camp, the alien race. The overall strength of the demon race in this world is much weaker than that of the alien race. The risk is not great for the Zerg to face it alone.

Moreover, the demon race is still fighting with various forces in the southern free land, and a large number of troops are tied up. The strong men on both sides are also in a state of mutual checks and balances.

At this time, the Zerg, which has not yet obtained the status of a large tribe, launched an attack on the demon tribe from its own territory, which is reasonable in all aspects.

If the Zerg performs well on the battlefield here, it will be of great help to the Zerg in obtaining the status of a large tribe.

The Zerg fought against the aliens and the demons at the same time, which was something that most large tribes did not dare to do. If the Zerg did this well, they could further prove the Zerg's strong strength and foundation to more people.

Once the decision was made, they began to act.

At dawn, several transport hosts carrying Zerg worker bees and a small number of Zerg guards set out from the Zerg territory and flew quickly to the northeast.

The transport hosts flew to the junction of the Zerg sphere of influence and the territory of the demons, at the foot of an endless mountain range, and dropped a large number of Zerg worker bees and a small number of Zerg guards.

More than half of the Zerg worker bees landed and began to upgrade and evolve to improve their star strength.

The Zerg worker bees began to dig underground at the location selected by Wu Qing and the Queen.

Since Wu Qing determined that the Zerg's sub-base could be built, it could transcend the space limit and automatically become part of the Zerg territory. He was ready to establish a sub-base in an important combat direction, send troops nearby, and improve combat efficiency.

Wu Qing planned to build a front-line base facing the demons at this location, so that there would be no need to dispatch troops from the distant Zerg base camp to fight against the demons.

The high-star Zerg worker bees were very efficient. They kept digging down until they reached a depth that the Zerg host could not detect, and then they began to dig the underground space horizontally to build the Zerg mother nest.

The Zerg worker bees dug space to build the Zerg mother nest, and the Zerg mother nest hatched Zerg worker bees. The Zerg worker bees continued to dig and expand the underground space and continue to build the Zerg mother nest.

In this way, like a snowball, a Zerg sub-base was quickly built.

This Zerg sub-base was automatically incorporated into the Zerg territory and had the protection ability of the lord of the Zerg territory.

With the Zerg sub-base under the 66th city as a precedent, this second Zerg sub-base only needed to follow the same pattern, and it would not be difficult to build it.

This Zerg sub-base was built on the mysterious Endless Mountains, so the underground is not necessarily safe. Wu Qing was afraid of digging up something bad, so this Zerg sub-base has more defensive buildings, and the defense system is much more sound than the Zerg sub-base under the 66th city.

Including this Zerg sub-base under construction, the Zerg now has three main bases.

The Zerg base camp in the initial land, the first sub-base under the 66th city, and the second sub-base under construction.

The Zerg base camp, the first sub-base, and the second sub-base, Wu Qing plans to distinguish these three Zerg bases in this way.

In the future, when there are more Zerg sub-bases, just call them the third, fourth, and fifth sub-bases in order, which is simple and convenient.
